design.primary_comparison: Adaptive development: spatial versus frequency routing, fixed center and shifted ROI controls, online same-state normalization; R77 U25/ROUTE rerun anchors

preregistration.primary: edit_ok AND subject_ok AND pattern_ok AND NOT artifact; all planned edits remain in denominator
preregistration.comparison: Rerun U25_KV and ROUTE25 anchors with internal same-run profiles; ROI_UNIFORM25 isolates full-correction spatial support; CENTER/SHIFT isolate ROI placement; ONLINE isolates budget acquisition.
preregistration.budget: ROUTE25/ROI_UNIFORM25/CENTER/SHIFT match realized U25 per-step applied RMS. ONLINE uses .25*rms(current correction*calibration*update mask) at its own state; self-normalized same-state RMS, not equal realized trajectory budget.
preregistration.cost: Six RF arms each91 standalone (28 inversion+63 edit), FlowEdit48; total8316 NFE. External-matched arm requires U25 profile91 in addition to own91: independent-inversion pair182. U25 is shared across four dependents in this batch; ONLINE needs no profile.
preregistration.annotation: Blind edit/subject/pattern/artifact labels, unscored stays pending; no VLM credential needed.
preregistration.selection: Freeze one final configuration using development semantic edit/subject/pattern/artifact labels. No automatic NCC selection. Confirm on distinct source holdout; no holdout images included in these 84 jobs.
preregistration.reporting: Native lossless PNG metrics; export compact thumbnails and scalar step summaries. Dog tasks share a source. Report task effects and uncertain judgments explicitly.
preregistration.result_status: Implemented; GPU generation and optional evaluation pending.

delivery.public_package: thumbnails, sheets, metrics, review, scalar step summaries and frozen reference previews
delivery.native_outputs: R78_EvidenceBridge/results on server only; raw PNG and full traces excluded from public ZIP

warnings: Fixed center control uses [128,128,384,384] for every source; no automatic localization claim.
Routed arms use supplied annotation or explicitly fixed controls; pattern_roi stays unchanged for evaluation.
ONLINE is self-normalized same-state RMS and does not match the independently realized U25 trajectory budget.
Final configuration frozen from development semantic labels; confirm on distinct source holdout.
Seven tasks use six sources; dog tasks share one source.
